Pikafish third-party component

Upstream: https://github.com/official-pikafish/Pikafish
Pinned release: Pikafish-2026-09-06
Source commit: 4c17cee11f888ae1d48a9494f2e2239f019f0a1f
Source: https://github.com/official-pikafish/Pikafish/tree/4c17cee11f888ae1d48a9494f2e2239f019f0a1f
Exact source archive is included as upstream-source-4c17cee.zip.

The ARM64 Android standalone executable is unchanged. It is renamed libpikafish.so only for Android APK packaging and is executed from the installer's read-only nativeLibraryDir, through public UCI standard input/output. useLegacyPackaging=true and keepDebugSymbols prevent unintentional stripping. No engine source or neural-network weights are modified. Other architectures use the separate original Kotlin search.

The executable/source are distributed under the upstream GNU GPL v3 terms in Copying.txt. Authors are listed in AUTHORS. The bundled neural-network weights have their own NNUE-License.md; it restricts commercial use without permission. Do not treat the training-data attribution in README.md as a replacement for the weight license. See the original files and release-manifest.json for exact members and SHA256 values.

This notice describes the upstream component and does not relicense unrelated application source. Any future distribution must preserve the corresponding source and the upstream licenses and notices.
